font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
